# Feature Request

Thank you for wanting to contribute to SNEEV! Please complete the following sections.

## Summary
A clear description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Motivation
Why is this feature needed? How would it benefit the project?

## Description
Describe the feature in detail. Include examples of how it would work.

## Implementation Ideas
 thoughts on how this could be implemented.

## UI/UX Thoughts
Any thoughts on the interaction design or visual style.

## Technical Considerations
Any ideas on the technical approach, or leave it open for the maintainers.

## Zazie Productions Aesthetic Fit
How does this fit the SNEEV / Zazie Productions conceptual framework?
